data.cultural_impact: The name 'Pradyotna' holds a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition as it symbolizes the power of light over darkness. It is believed that light has the power to dispel ignorance and illuminate the path to knowledge. The name is also associated with prosperity, success, and brilliance in various aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Pradyotna' represents the inner light of consciousness that illuminates the soul. It is believed that each individual is born with this inner light, which can be nurtured and brought forth through disciplined practice and spiritual growth. The name is a reminder that just as a lamp casts light in the physical world, the light of the soul can outshine the darkness of ignorance and suffering.

historical_references.reference: Pradyotna was a legendary king mentioned in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata. He was the king of the Haihayas, a powerful dynasty in ancient India. Pradyotna is known for his great valor and justice, and he was a generous and noble ruler. He was a descendant of the lunar dynasty and ruled in the region of Mathura in present-day Uttar Pradesh, India.

Pradyotna was also a king in medieval Orissa, India, who ruled during the 13th century CE. He is known for his military prowess and his efforts to expand the territories of his kingdom. He is mentioned in various Orissan inscriptions and texts, including the Dhauli Inscription, which records his military victories.
